title: Capsule Review: true-sequence image-change selection development pilot
honesty_note: The s288 images, size, and anatomical class counts were previously inspected; s288 is post-hoc exploratory development, not an independent evaluation. This design must be frozen before inspecting any new studies.
future_study_selection_rule: Choose the two smallest complete per-study nested ZIP files from the published Study 276-300 bundle, excluding already explored s288, using verified archive index member size only. Freeze these IDs before decoding any images.
preserved_source: Rhode Island GI VCE collection v1, official source ndownloader.figshare.com/files/37560007, published article 21183970, publisher paper DOI 10.1038/s41597-022-01726-3
ordering: numeric original source filename stem, not filesystem or ZIP member order; reject index gaps, duplicates, unexpected folders, and inconsistent image decoding
study_unit: complete published study, not independently identified patient; patient-level independence is unknown
image_change: Absolute RGB difference on consecutive 64x64 bilinear-resized frames, mean across all RGB pixels /255 including borders. Candidate i>0 uses change between frame i-1 and i; frame 0 gets score 0. No anatomy-label input to policy.
endpoints: For k>=2 always include first and last positions; k=1 use the midpoint.

methods.uniform: Integer-spaced endpoints via floor(j*(n-1)/(k-1)), j in [0,k)
methods.global_change: Include endpoints; fill k-2 positions by descending adjacent-image change, ties toward earlier position.
methods.stratified_change: Include endpoints; partition remaining interior positions into k-2 non-overlapping contiguous equal-quantile bins and select maximum adjacent change from each bin; ties toward earlier position.
methods.random_anchored: Include endpoints; sample k-2 remaining positions uniformly without replacement, seeded random.Random(17 + draw_index), 100 draws.

anatomy_boundary: First position of each new anatomical folder in the official Rhode Island source; only four region labels, not lesion boundaries.
timestamp_status: original acquisition timestamps unavailable; source order does not establish elapsed time
budget_gate: Do not transfer more than 512 MiB in additional source data or purchase compute without user approval; do not bypass network restrictions
future_study_content_access_status: not yet acquired at time of this preregistration
